settings.question: Which professions are approved for CE credit?
settings.answer: CFBL Institute trainings are approved for CE credit for LCSWs, LPCs, psychologists (PA, DE, MD), and PMHNPs. Check the course page for your state's approval status.

settings.question: What is the cancellation policy?
settings.answer: Full refunds are available up to 7 days before the event. After that, credit toward a future training is available with 48-hour notice.

settings.question: How will I receive my CE certificate?
settings.answer: Certificates of completion are issued within 5 business days of the training. You must complete the full training and post-test (where required) to receive credit.

settings.question: Are group rates available?
settings.answer: Yes. Groups of 5 or more from the same organization receive a 15% discount. Contact the Institute to arrange group registration.

settings.heading: Questions about this training?
settings.subheading: Contact the Institute for group rates, custom arrangements, or CE approval questions.
